runtime_interfaces.gateway_log: systemd journal for the profile gateway unit

source_contracts.scheduler: public cron-history CLI: one exact job execution and terminal status
source_contracts.model_attempt: disposable local OpenAI-compatible provider logs each request before responding
source_contracts.delivery: disposable local sink append-only JSONL with exact correlation_id and job_id
source_contracts.model_success_and_tokens: the same provider event records terminal outcome and controlled response usage; positive control also requires completed cron history and delivery
source_contracts.session: public sessions CLI in a disposable dedicated HERMES_HOME

limitations: The pinned CLI outputs human-readable rows rather than JSON; the collector parses only the exact pinned 0.20.0 grammar and fails closed on other shapes.
Correlation requires a disposable exclusive profile, one fixture execution, exact job/correlation IDs, and bounded before/after snapshots.
Provider-reported usage is acceptable only for the controlled disposable OpenAI-compatible fixture; it is not an accounting source for production providers.
Hermes 0.20.0 does not persist a successful Telegram receipt/message identity; the harness proves correlated delivery attempts or their absence, not human receipt.
